name: Chip & Dales Iron Works
old_description: Founded in 1993, Chip and Dale's Iron Works has proudly served our local community for over 30 years, delivering high-quality custom metal fabrication, structural steel, and ornamental ironwork. From gates and railings to large-scale structural projects, we ensure compliance with HOA requirements or restoration.
about:
Chip & Dales Iron Works was founded in 1993 in Oregon City, Oregon. The company has served the greater Portland metro area for over three decades, providing custom metal fabrication, structural steel, and ornamental ironwork for both residential and commercial clients.

The shop produces a range of custom metal products including ornamental iron fencing, security gates and enclosures, driveway and pedestrian gates, metal staircases, wrought iron railings, Juliet balconies, deck railings, and one‑off fabrications such as gazebos, chandeliers, garden arbors, and fireplace screens. On the commercial side it delivers ADA‑compliant railings, custom mezzanines, and industrial staircases, handling projects from initial design through final installation. Processes include custom metal fabrication, structural steel work, ornamental ironwork, and hand‑forging.

Customers span homeowners, businesses, and commercial property owners throughout the Portland region. The company regularly works with homeowners associations to meet HOA requirements and takes on restoration projects. Its commercial portfolio includes projects for businesses of all sizes, from retail spaces to industrial facilities.

The firm states that its commitment to quality and service sets it apart, emphasizing craftsmanship, reliability, and attention to detail. It specializes in custom designs tailored to each client’s vision and ensures compliance with HOA guidelines or restoration standards.

name: Clackamas Auto Parts
old_description: Proudly serving Oregon City and the surrounding communities since 1934, Clackamas Auto Parts is your locally owned, family-run source for quality automotive parts and trusted machine shop services. Whether you're a DIY enthusiast, professional installer, or part of a commercial fleet, our experienced team is here to help with personalized service, in-depth product knowledge, and an inventory you can count on.
about:
Clackamas Auto Parts has operated from Oregon City, Oregon since 1934. The business remains family-owned and locally run, serving the surrounding communities for nine decades. Founders are not named in available records.

The company combines a retail auto parts operation with an in-house machine shop. The parts inventory covers modern and vintage vehicles, with a focus on hard-to-find components for classic cars. The machine shop provides brake rotor and drum machining, flywheel machining, cylinder head resurfacing and rebuilding, custom engine rebuilding, engine block boring, axle bearing press work, and spray cabinet cleaning. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include DIY enthusiasts, professional installers, and commercial fleets in the Oregon City area. The shop is noted as one of the few remaining in-house automotive machine shops in the region, attracting vintage vehicle owners and local repair shops that need machining services alongside parts supply.

The company emphasizes its knowledgeable staff with decades of experience, personalized service, and the ability to source obsolete vintage parts that are not in stock. These factors, along with the rare combination of retail parts and machine work under one roof, are cited as key differentiators.

name: Classic Metal Craft
old_description: Classic Metal Craft, Inc. has been in business since 1989. We have built a reputation for quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. CMC is owned by the Zadrozinski family. Quality and craftsmanship have long been the Hallmark for CMC’s success. We will continue to invest in our people, as well as, technology to better serve our customers. We hope to earn your business and your referrals.
about:
Classic Metal Craft, Inc. has operated from St. Louis, Missouri since 1989. The company is owned by the Zadrozinski family, with Peter Zadrozinski the business. It began as a specialist in ornamental ironwork, building a reputation for quality workmanship and customer satisfaction over more than three decades.

The firm produces custom ornamental ironwork ranging from standard wrought-iron fencing and handrails to hand-forged decorative pieces. Its in-house capabilities include custom fabrication of balconies, juliet balconies, drive gates, portico entrance gates, farm entrance gates, spiral stairs, custom table bases, and integrated exterior lighting. A showroom and production facility at 1315 S. Vandeventer houses experienced craftsmen who handle welding, forging, laser cutting, and CAD-based design visualization.

Classic Metal Craft serves residential homeowners, architects, and commercial contractors throughout the St. Louis region. Recent projects include a modern drive gate for a Clayton home, a farm entrance gate matching an existing wood fence, a six-foot-diameter spiral stair with laser-cut treads for a West County residence, and a custom iron table base supporting a 250-pound solid wood top in a kitchenette. The company also works on commercial installations, providing CAD drawings for project visualization.

The Zadrozinski family emphasizes employee loyalty and continuous investment in technology as differentiators. Craftsmen often stay with the company for years, and the firm uses CAD to bring client visions to reality before fabrication begins. Quality and craftsmanship are cited as the hallmarks of its success, with a focus on matching existing architectural details and meeting strict design constraints such as maximum opening sizes for pet safety.

name: Classic Metal LLC
old_description: From garage-built beginnings to a thriving family business, Classic Metal has been shaped by grit, craftsmanship, and legacy. Founded in 1999 and now led by father-son duo Wade and Reid Usey, our story is one of dedication passed down through generations.
about:
Classic Metal LLC operates from Pearl, Mississippi, where it was founded in 1999 as Copper Creations by Wade Usey. The business began in a garage, with Usey self-teaching metal fabrication to supply roofing products that were otherwise unavailable locally. His wife Jackie assisted on a metal brake while he installed pieces on job sites. In 2022 the company rebranded to Classic Metal and formalized its structure, now led by the father‑son team of Wade and Reid Usey.

The shop produces custom metal roofing components including roof flashing, chimney caps, conductor heads, finials, standing seam panels, vents, awnings, and chimney crickets. Work is performed on metal brakes and forming equipment, with the team handling everything from single-piece prototypes to recurring orders for builders. Headcount is described as "several employees" supporting a workflow built on hands‑on craftsmanship rather than high‑volume automation.

Primary customers are residential roofers, new‑construction builders, gutter companies, and individual homeowners across the local region. The company also supplies roofing contractors and has begun targeting broader markets in neighboring states. Long‑standing relationships with area builders date back to the founder’s early roofing career.

The business was started to fill a gap in locally sourced, essential roofing metalwork. Usey’s self‑taught expertise and the generational transfer of trade knowledge are cited as the foundation of their reliability. The leadership emphasizes personalized service, expert guidance, and products designed to endure, aiming to expand that reputation beyond Mississippi.

name: Clay Furniture Industries
old_description: Since 1981 Clay Furniture has focused on producing commercial cabinetry solutions for a wealth of customers large and small, both locally and nationally. We serve direct customer relationships, general contractors, architects, and interior designers, from our 18,000/sf facility located in Hartford, CT.
about:
Clay Furniture Industries, founded in 1981 by Richard and Julie Clay, is based in Manchester, Connecticut. The company operates an 18,000-square-foot production facility in nearby Hartford. In recent years, Drew Hodgdon and Brandon Knowlden acquired the business and continue its original focus on commercial cabinetry and millwork.

The firm provides commercial cabinetry, custom millwork, and design-build services from a single location. Its capabilities include shop drawing preparation, estimating, and fabrication in laminate, solid surface, and various wood species. The design-build model consolidates design and manufacturing under one roof, serving clients who lack an in-house architect or designer.

Clay Furniture serves general contractors, subcontractors, architects, interior designers, and direct commercial clients across education, hospitality, healthcare, state and local government, and corporate environments. Project types range from classrooms and laboratories to dental offices, medical exam rooms, reception areas, and retail spaces.

The company emphasizes its integrated design-build approach and material versatility as key differentiators, aiming to deliver cohesion and efficiency for projects that require custom millwork solutions.

name: Clean Energy USA
old_description: Delaware solar needs local experts. That's what Clean Energy USA gives you. Since 2007, we've been serving Delaware homes and businesses. Our solar experts know your needs. We create easy installations for maximum savings. This means lower costs right away and better incentives that give you real returns.
about:
Clean Energy USA was founded in 2007 in Rehoboth Beach, Delaware. The company operates as part of the Schell Brothers family of businesses, giving it a family-owned structure from the start.

The firm specializes in residential and commercial solar panel installations across Delaware. Beyond solar, it offers generator systems, electric-vehicle charging stations, and Span smart panels, positioning itself as a full clean-energy partner. The company reports thousands of completed installations and a 95.5% customer satisfaction rate, though it does not disclose facility size or headcount.

Its customers are Delaware homeowners and businesses seeking to reduce electricity costs and lock in energy rates. The company handles everything from site assessment and installation to maintenance and the filing of state and federal incentive paperwork.

Clean Energy USA emphasizes its local expertise—knowledge of Delaware's permitting rules, weather patterns, and rebate programs—as its primary differentiator. Being embedded in the Schell Brothers family also allows it to draw on broader construction and home-service resources, which the company says translates into smoother project execution.

name: Clore Furniture
old_description: The Clore Family has lived and worked in the heart of Virginia since 1830, doing what they love and doing it very well. Through the years, Clore heirloom-quality furniture has come to be regarded as quintessentially American—functional, beautiful, and enduring.
about:
Clore Furniture operates from Madison, Virginia, where the Clore family has been crafting furniture since 1830. The business remains family-owned, with Troy Coppage serving as company president. The enterprise began as a multigenerational workshop in the heart of Virginia, building pieces intended to last for generations.

The company produces handcrafted furniture using traditional fabrication methods, offering a range of woods, finishes, and custom design options. In addition to new pieces, Clore provides restoration services for existing furniture. The workshop handles both standard catalog items and customized commissions, though specific production volumes and facility size are not disclosed.

Clore serves residential customers through its showroom and caters to institutional clients, as indicated by a dedicated institutions section. The firm emphasizes longstanding relationships with clients who value heirloom-quality pieces built for real-life use.

The company distinguishes itself through a commitment to sustainable sourcing and a philosophy that each piece is built as if it were destined for the craftsmen's own homes. This approach, maintained over more than 180 years, underpins its reputation for functional, beautiful, and enduring American furniture.

name: Collins Sheet Metal Inc.
old_description: Your local sheet metal fabrication shop. Collins Sheet Metal, Inc serving the good people of Berwick, ME, and surrounding areas since 1985. We work with metals varying in thickness from 26 gauge to 1/2 inch. A few of our jobs have even required 1 inch! Custom metal fabrication, duct systems, machine guarding, hoods, dust collection systems, stairways, railings, bending, shearing, welding, plasma cutting, steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper work, flashings, pans and more. Your one-stop-shop for design, fabrication, CNC machining, waterjet cutting, welding, and finishing.
about:
Collins Sheet Metal, Inc. has operated from Berwick, Maine since 1985. The family-owned business was started by Gary Collins Sr. in a home garage and has since expanded to a 10,000-square-foot facility.

The shop provides custom sheet metal fabrication including duct systems, machine guarding, hoods, dust collection, stairways, railings, and architectural metalwork. Processes cover bending, shearing, welding, plasma cutting, CNC machining, waterjet cutting, laser cutting, punching, and finishing. Materials range from 26-gauge to 1/2-inch thick steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and copper, with occasional 1-inch jobs.

Customers span residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company built its reputation on custom residential ductwork, which still accounts for 70–90% of installed ductwork made in-house. Industrial projects include an aviation platform for a local airport, machine guarding with manual rising shields, burner chambers for automotive hot-air molding, kitchen exhaust hoods, stainless steel diverting chutes, portable holding tanks, restaurant shelving, and backsplashes.

Collins emphasizes fair pricing, a one-year warranty on parts and labor, and satisfaction guaranteed. The team focuses on problem-solving, turning customer drawings into finished products on time and on budget.

name: Collision Auto Parts
old_description: The premier auto body and cooling parts distributor serving Northern California since 2005. We sell certified, as well as non-certified, quality auto body parts from all the top brands at competitive prices. We are fully licensed, insured, and bonded for your peace of mind. Whether you’re installing the body part yourself or trusting your favorite body shop, the money you save means you’ll feel as good as your car will look.
about:
Collision Auto Parts, headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, traces its roots to 2005 when National Auto Parts began serving Northern California. The company rebranded to Collision Auto Parts (COL) and now operates as three entities running distribution facilities across California and New Mexico.

The firm functions as a value-added distributor of certified and non-certified aftermarket collision repair parts. Its product lineup spans bumper covers, grilles, fender lines, hoods, headlamps, taillamps, and cooling components such as radiators and AC condensers. Seven distribution centers — located in Sacramento, Santa Rosa, Hayward, Fresno, Calexico, Santa Fe Springs, San Diego, and Albuquerque — support a daily delivery fleet that moves parts to shops throughout the Western U.S. Every component undergoes a 100 percent inspection both on receipt and before shipment.

Customers include national and regional multi-shop operators (MSOs), independent collision repair centers, and do-it-yourself installers. The company emphasizes direct-from-manufacturer purchasing, which it says yields savings of 20 to 80 percent versus original-equipment prices, and it matches competitor list prices.

Collision Auto Parts was built on a philosophy of exceeding customer expectations through honesty, innovation, and continuous improvement. Its stated differentiators include the inspection guarantee, same-day or next-day delivery via its own trucks, CAPA-certified inventory availability, and a technical team that assists with part selection and repair guidance.
